name: Five Nights at Candy's 4 Fan-Concept
storyline:
In ####, Rowboatics Corp. and CTC Entertainment are continuing some old operations and ideas in the new Rowboatics Corporate Headquarters. Both companies are quietly and secretly developing new tech for an undisclosed project.

Rowboatics is currently seeking a nighttime technician to take care of critical systems and complete assigned objectives throughout a specific floor in their headquarters.

During the epilogue, you play as a former employee of Rowboatics Corp. Years ago, this employee left after a series of incidents that Rowboatics Corp. and CTC Entertainment chose to ignore. Some events that were quietly brushed aside without care or prevention. But now, facing unfortunate struggles, this employee accepted an offer sent to former staff members of Rowboatics asking them to return for a temporary nighttime technician position tied to a new private project.

Throughout the week, this employee must carry out the tasks assigned to them and keep the facility operational through the week before the launch of both Rowboatics and CTC’s new project.
summary: Five Nights at Candy’s 4 (Fan-Concept) is a fan-concept that envisions what the 4th installment in the Five Nights at Candy’s series could be like, while being the most accurate version of the real game thus far.
